properties.evidence: dec:mosa-conformance (2026-07-25) named this gap 18 months of design-time before it was measured: under WHAT IS GENUINELY MISSING it records '(2) NOTHING CHECKS STANDARDS COMPLIANCE, and the vocabulary for it is present and unused: DesignRule is defined as a chosen standard or convention with an `enforced` flag, and there are zero DesignRules in any graph.' The population has since gone 0 -> 27 while the check stayed at zero, and this finding supplies the mechanism it could not have known: VIOLATES_RULE and COMPLIES_WITH resolve to EnvironmentRule, so no served path reaches a DesignRule at all.
